simple.meaning: טָעַן (ṭâʻan) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to load a beast.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Genesis, beginning at Genesis 45:17. The surrounding contexts include family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָעַן (H2943) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: טָעַן (ṭâʻan) / H2943 is traced through Genesis 45:17 with source-language evidence and verse context.
